is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s., Anopheles coluzzii, and Anopheles arabiensis (page 1, Abstract; page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation using PCR according to Martinez-Torres et al. (page 3, 'Determination of the L1014F mutation of the kdr gene in the three species').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives exact genotype counts (1014F/1014F, 1014F/1014L, 1014L/1014L) and allelic frequencies across seven agro-ecological zones for both An. gambiae and An. coluzzii.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from natural breeding sites in 18 localities across Benin from May 2015 to December 2017 and reared to adulthood (page 3, 'Larvae collections and mosquito rearing').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article reporting original field collections, species PCR, and kdr genotyping in Benin.

sub_country_location.evidence: Table 1 provides specific localities and geographic coordinates (e.g., Malanville 11°51'48"N 3°23'3,29"E; Kandi 11°7'49,869"N 2°55'57,282"E, etc.) across seven agro-ecological zones.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collections were conducted between May 2015 and December 2017 (<= 3 years; page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field surveys conducted by CREC across Benin with no indication of overlap with external consortia or published datasets.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and allelic frequencies by agro-ecological zone and species are fully reported in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study surveyed 18 localities in seven agro-ecological zones of Benin from May 2015 to December 2017, identifying Anopheles coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis. A total of 677 mosquitoes were analysed, with complete genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allelic frequencies for the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation presented across agro-ecological zones.
